english.title: Taxi fail to carry / provide reasonable assistance with luggage - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a taxi, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), that was constructed or adapted so as to be capable of carrying luggage, failed without reasonable cause or lawful excuse, on being requested by a person at Liverpool John Lennon Airport who had hired or sought to hire the carriage, to

(A)_[convey a reasonable quantity of luggage]_
(B)_[afford reasonable assistance in loading or unloading luggage]_
(C)_[afford reasonable assistance in removing luggage to or from the terminal building at which such person could be taken up or set down]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 7(11) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
